Original CFRU/DPE: Skeli, ghoulslash and upstream contributors.
Expansion: Shiny-Miner and contributors named in the upstream README files.
HQ mixer assembly: ipatix, GPLv3; retained in the compiled source, optional HQ installation disabled.
Additional upstream credits: see the pinned repositories and CFRU Documentation.pdf.

Studio changes reserve a 144-byte project record in SaveBlock2, preserve base NPC scripts,
retain the stock audio allocation, and explicitly target ARM7TDMI during assembly.
Corresponding source: pinned upstream repositories plus scripts/engine-patches and
scripts/build-expanded-engine.py in https://github.com/xbaconator9000x/pokebacon-studio.
Artwork retains upstream attribution and permissions; this notice assigns no new rights.
